name: DevDesk Base
description: Base development environment with mise, common CLI tools, and supervisor

packages.description: Comma-separated list of mise packages to install (format: name@version)

npmGlobalPackages.description: Comma-separated list of npm global packages to install

cargoPackages.description: Comma-separated list of cargo packages to install (e.g. cargo-watch,tokei)

extraPackages.description: Extra mise packages to install on top of defaults (format: name@version)

extraNpmGlobalPackages.description: Extra npm global packages to install on top of defaults

extraCargoPackages.description: Extra cargo packages to install on top of defaults
